name: walk
prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Make a SIX FRAME WALK cycle sprite sheet for exactly this skeletal protagonist. Reference: identity and clothes and short steel sword, not poses. 3 columns by 2 rows, ordered left-to-right then next row. Full figure facing RIGHT in every cell, transparent background no ground shadow/text. Same narrow skull, thin ivory bones, brown rag scarf/loincloth, one short sword in same hand held down forward, light upper left. Complete walking cycle: right foot contact, right passing, right push-off, left contact, left passing, left push-off. Distinct articulated legs and weight transfer; small natural rag follow-through, torso nearly upright, no running. Keep identical anatomical lengths and uniform scale in all 6 cells; feet at same relative cell baseline, root centered. Each cell 512x512 with ample empty margins, no clipping, no VFX. Do not change weapon or outfit. Detailed restrained pixel sprite style matching reference.

name: run
prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. SIX FRAME RUN cycle for precisely the reference skeletal protagonist, not redesign. 3 columns 2 rows, left-to-right timeline. Uniform anatomical size, all facing RIGHT sideview. Very thin ivory skeleton, narrow skull, ragged brown scarf loincloth, same short straight dark steel sword in same hand. Aggressive forward torso lean, long powerful strides, alternating leg contacts and tuck/passing/extension: right contact, flight right leg behind, left passing, left contact, flight left behind, right passing. Distinct six poses making smooth looping RUN clearly faster than upright WALK. No dust or effects. Same root and relative ground baseline in cells; keep consistent skull and bone lengths even during tuck. Transparent RGBA background no glow no shadow no text, generous blank gutters, entire character and sword visible. Pixel art style same as reference, muted bone/brown/steel, upper left light.

name: attack-light
prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. TWO distinct 4-frame sword attacks for reference skeleton hero. Transparent 4 columns x2 rows sprite sheet. SAME thin ivory skeleton narrow skull, brown torn scarf/loincloth, same short straight steel sword held in same hand throughout, facing RIGHT all frames, fixed anatomical scale/root/ground baseline, upper-left light, no text no shadows no VFX. Top row M1 THRUST timeline: frame1 immediate fully extended horizontal thrust sword right at chest level, frame2 follow-through extended, frame3 elbow retracts blade horizontal, frame4 returns to low ready. Bottom row M2 DIAGONAL CUT timeline: frame1 immediate powerful diagonal downward slash sword forward and down (NO arc effect), frame2 low follow-through across body, frame3 wrist/arm recover blade, frame4 return ready. No startup delay since gameplay hits immediately. Clearly linear thrust vs diagonal slash. Full figures and sword inside cells, generous spacing, no overlap. Pixel art same identity/outfit/weapon length as reference. Never enlarge sword. Four distinct phases each row.
